data.body: Phase 2 evidence: RED before fix was `pytest -q -x tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_outbound_comment_marker_survives_truncation.py`, failing at `test_pytest_current_test_values_fit_windows_environment` with `ValueError: the environment variable is longer than 32767 characters`. After adding explicit ids, collect showed `collected=16 over_limit=0` and the long cases had short nodeids `[far_over_limit]` and `[over_limit_multiline]`; focused module passed `15 passed`. Sandboxed mutation evidence (macOS `sandbox-exec` profile allowing writes only under this worktree/.debug-b4f5-sandbox and stdio): replacing both explicit ids with bare tuples returned the held-out test to RED, `MUTATION_EXIT=1`, with the same `ValueError`; the script restored the file. Validation: `make lint` passed, focused+mutate suite `685 passed, 1 skipped`; full local default suite has unrelated baseline failure in `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py::test_relevant_remote_rejection_never_places_candidate_on_shared_head`, reproduced unchanged after restoring this patch. Gerrit change 2469 passed LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 and was submitted/merged.
